# ffxf_vm_rdns (Resource)

Configures reverse DNS for an IP address assigned to a virtual machine. Destroying the resource clears the custom record and restores the default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_vm_rdns" "example" {
  vm_id    = 123
  address  = "2001:db8::42"
  hostname = "vm.example.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address assigned to the VM.
- `hostname` (String) Reverse-DNS hostname to associate with the address.
- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the virtual machine.
